# JUDO PSM Generator JAX-RS

> Generates complete Jakarta RESTful Web Services (JAX-RS) Java code from JUDO Platform Specific Model (PSM) definitions, producing API interfaces, DTOs, service implementations, and OSGi component wrappers.

Key facts:
- Java 21, Maven 3.9.4 multi-module project (5 modules)
- Uses Handlebars templates with `@TemplateHelper` Java classes for code generation
- Template-to-model mapping configured declaratively in `psm-jaxrs.yaml` files using Spring Expression Language (SpEL)
- Generates four layers: API interfaces/DTOs, service implementations, OSGi wrappers, and shared fragments
- Supports optional OpenAPI/Swagger annotation generation and Java `Optional` type wrapping
- OSGi bundle packaging via maven-bundle-plugin
- License: Eclipse Public License 2.0 (EPL-2.0)

## Modules

- [judo-psm-generator-jaxrs-common/pom.xml](judo-psm-generator-jaxrs-common/pom.xml): Shared Handlebars template fragments (e.g., license headers) used by all layers
- [judo-psm-generator-jaxrs-api/pom.xml](judo-psm-generator-jaxrs-api/pom.xml): API layer generation — REST service interfaces, request/response/create-request DTOs, enumerations, query customizers, range objects, error/detail classes
- [judo-psm-generator-jaxrs-impl/pom.xml](judo-psm-generator-jaxrs-impl/pom.xml): Implementation layer — concrete service implementations, application config, REST utility classes
- [judo-psm-generator-jaxrs-osgi/pom.xml](judo-psm-generator-jaxrs-osgi/pom.xml): OSGi component wrappers with `@Component` declarations for service registration
- [judo-psm-generator-jaxrs-test/pom.xml](judo-psm-generator-jaxrs-test/pom.xml): Unit tests for Jackson serialization with `Optional` types, validates DTO serialization contracts

## Depends on

- [judo-meta-psm](../../models/judo-meta-psm): PSM metamodel — foundational platform-specific data model
- [cxf-jaxrs-application-manager](../../runtime/cxf-jaxrs-application-manager): JAX-RS application lifecycle management for OSGi with Apache CXF
- [judo-dao-api](../../runtime/judo-dao-api): Core DAO interfaces for CRUD, query, navigation, and validation
- [judo-dispatcher-api](../../runtime/judo-dispatcher-api): Dispatcher API contracts for routing API calls to runtime actions
- [judo-generator-commons](../../runtime/judo-generator-commons): Handlebars template-based code generation framework
- [judo-sdk-common](../../runtime/judo-sdk-common): Base classes for generated SDK — entity identity, DAO base, and query filters

## Used by

- [judo-platform](../../runtime/judo-platform): Model-driven OSGi runtime platform with REST APIs and Karaf deployment
